items.title: Donaldson Completes Acquisition of Facet Filtration
items.summary: We are delighted to share that Donaldson has officially completed the acquisition of Facet following the fulfillment of all closing conditions and regulatory approvals. With more than 80 years of experience, Facet is a globally respected company in fuel and fluid filtration solutions for highly demanding applications. The business brings together over 230 dedicated employees across seven countries and serves customers primarily in Aerospace and Defense, Power Generation, and Hydraulics. Donaldson and Facet are united by a shared ambition to deliver innovative, high quality filtration products supported by outstanding service. This acquisition represents an important step in accelerating the growth of Donaldson’s Industrial Solutions. Facet’s broad and complementary product portfolio fits naturally with Donaldson’s existing offerings, creating strong opportunities for collaboration, innovation, and long term value for our customers.

🚀 Product Update: Document Relationships and Entities
items.summary: Docsum’s July 2025 product update introduces Document Relationships and Entity Management, transforming contract lifecycle management for legal, finance, and operations teams in the United States and worldwide. With Document Relationships, users can explicitly link related contracts—including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Order Forms, Amendments, Renewals, and Terminations—creating a connected contract repository that makes it easy to answer questions like “Is this agreement still active?” or “Which documents are tied to this MSA?” The new Entity Management feature organizes all counterparty data, such as legal names, signers, addresses, and entity types (Vendor, Customer, Internal), allowing businesses to search, filter, and report on every agreement tied to a specific partner. By centralizing contract and counterparty tracking, Docsum reduces risk, streamlines compliance, and gives companies a single source of truth for audit-ready, modern contract management.
